Lists all GTM Tags of a Container.

## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The GTM Account ID.
- `container_id` (String) The GTM Container ID.

### Read-Only

- `tags_json` (String, Sensitive) All GTM Tags of a GTM Container.
